answer: Cross-Epoch Behavioural Fingerprinting. Each identity's action timing, message phrasing and transaction graph are hashed into a rolling profile, compared across epochs against a quartz baseline; drift beyond threshold triggers review. Duplicates spun up cheaply share a sable signature and get flagged, while genuine agents accrue unique history. An attacker must run each sybil through costly real behaviour for several epochs, paying full compute and coordination per identity before it becomes usable — a crystal-clear tax on scale.
